answer: Sequential effort anchor: each agent identity must solve a chained proof-of-work whose difficulty is calibrated to elapsed real time, and the solution hash is bound to the prior block, forming a violet-sealed lineage. New identities start at genesis; skipping ahead requires redoing every intermediate step. An attacker cloning N identities pays N× the full sequential wall-clock cost and cannot parallelize it, while honest agents amortize by extending one chain.
